content.text: No MFN obligation on Customer exists anywhere; § 12.3 expressly disclaims one.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation or most-favoured-customer obligation on Customer. Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and the pricing provisions (§ 7.1 fixed Fees; § 8.3 capped renewal uplift) impose no duty on Customer to extend Vendor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation); no redline is required. Separate exclusivity (§ 2.2) and non-compete (§ 12.4) issues are outside this rule and are addressed under their own playbook rules.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
